The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `27017` (see `MongoDbAtlasLocalBuilder.MongoDbAtlasLocalPort`)
- Environment variable: `MONGODB_INITDB_ROOT_USERNAME=mongo` (see `MongoDbAtlasLocalBuilder.WithUsername(string)`)
- Environment variable: `MONGODB_INITDB_ROOT_PASSWORD=mongo` (see `MongoDbAtlasLocalBuilder.WithPassword(string)`)
- Environment variable: `DO_NOT_TRACK=1`
- Wait strategy: Waits until the command `runner healthcheck` is completed successfully.
